text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Flood waters sweeping down the Pungwe river in central Mozambique have forced more than 1,000 families to evacuate their homes and left four people dead when their canoe capsized.
- A round of fresh talks between South Africa and Mozambique are scheduled in February to set a new price for electricity from the Cahora Bassa dam on the Zambezi river.
